2117227865062457748.en_summary: JUST IN: Marvell $MRVL to acquire Lumentum $LITE in a $115B all-stock deal
2117227865062457748.zh_summary: 最新：Marvell $MRVL 將以 1150 億美元全股票交易收購 Lumentum $LITE。

2117227565727543576.en_summary: $MRVL just made a ~$115B bet on the future of AI infrastructure, agreeing to acquire $LITE in an all-stock deal. Marvell CEO Matt Murphy calls this “an opportunity that comes along once in a generation” as traditional copper connections start hitting their limits with rising AI bandwidth demands. By combining Lumentum’s lasers and optical transceivers with Marvell’s networking silicon, the combined company is targeting a $550B addressable market as data centers increasingly shift toward optical connectivity.
2117227565727543576.zh_summary: $MRVL 剛對 AI 基礎設施的未來押下約 1150 億美元賭注，同意以全股票交易收購 $LITE。Marvell CEO Matt Murphy 稱這是「一代人一次的機會」，因為傳統銅連接開始受到 AI 頻寬需求上升的限制。結合 Lumentum 的激光器和光學收發器與 Marvell 的網絡硅片，合併公司瞄準 5500 億美元的可寻址市場，數據中心正日益轉向光學連接。

ticker_notes.MRVL: 以約 $115B 全股票收購 LITE，瞄準 $550B 光學市場
